facts.title: Jessica's Marinated Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 cans (15 ounces each) chickpeas, rinsed and drained, or 3 cups cooked chickpeas
⅔ cup chopped roasted red peppers
4 medium cloves garlic, pressed or minced
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
½ teaspoon red pepper flakes (scale back significantly if sensitive to spice)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
